answers.reasoning: Let B=(5 cos t, 5 sin t), 0≤t≤π/2, since B traverses the first-quadrant quarter-circle of radius 5 from A=(5,0). The centroid G of O=(0,0), A=(5,0), and B is G=((5+5 cos t)/3, (5 sin t)/3)=(5/3,0)+(5/3)(cos t,sin t). Thus G traces a quarter-circle of radius 5/3 as t runs from 0 to π/2. Its arc length is (5/3)(π/2)=5π/6, which is choice ②; exactly one choice matches.
